title: Python drives R
description: Pull mtcars out of R, group it in Python, send the table back and fit lm() in R. One script, both sessions.
steps: Press Run. fs.R.mtcars arrives in Python as a Frame.
fs.R.by_cyl = rows makes an R data.frame; fs.r(...) returns lm() coefficients as a dict.
Type by_cyl in the R console: the table exists there too.
